summary: Publishes eligibility-scoped offers that workers pull and claim; initiates, settles and preempts execution runs. Invites work and never takes it. From seed/3 it mints qualifications from eval passes, disqualifies configurations eval fails name, and publishes the offers waiting evals need (seed eval act).
inbox: Push channels wake; position-stamped reads convince. A wake, an event or a message is a hint to re-read, never a fact about the world.
